decisions.rationale: Engaged admin: onboarding call held (calendar:e88fa689), praised product (tick_7a697c43fce8), asked about seats (email:e36bc136) suggesting team intent. But 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone, and 8 days left; starter plan, momentum unproven.

draft.subject: Following up after your onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for the kind words on the onboarding flow, and for the seats question Tariq picked up -- seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

Since our call, the main thing left is getting one real Union Works project in place. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that first one tends to make everything else fall into place. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
